scope: Scope: 5 held-out tasks (ho1 English PR description, ho2 Spanish release notes, ho3 Brazilian Portuguese incident note, ho4 Dutch status update (clean source), ho5 English README intro), 11 arms, 3 runs each (165 cells), model claude-sonnet-5-5, Claude Agent SDK path (CLI 2.1.308, no Artifact tool), 2026-10-22, macOS sandbox-exec write sandbox with scrubbed environment, parallelism 3, scored by the script heldout/score.mjs (5 points per run). Code under test: commit 5eb1a61 (product code of 7cba348). No cell is reused from an earlier round. The public tasks h1 to h18, Haiku and Opus (F9) and the independent re-grade (F6) were not run.
claim: Scoped result sentence: on 5 held-out tasks written by an agent that saw no code, in 11 arms with 3 runs each on claude-sonnet-5-5 through the Agent SDK on 2026-10-22, the ours arm is NOT first on both rules (see the Rule A and Rule B lines above); no leadership claim follows from this round, and the public-task, F9 and F6 parts of the gate were not run.
departures: Amendment A of the protocol (committed before any run beyond the first 15 cells) restored all 11 arms and 3 runs after the first 15 cells had run under the reduced plan; the first 15 cells stay in the set.
One cell (ho4-unslop-inv-2) was killed by SIGTERM (not a rate limit), had no valid transcript, was re-run by the same command and only the valid run is scored.
The three scan arms run as natural arms only (avoid-ai-writing, slopless, slop-cop), not as -inv arms, as stated in amendment A.
Held-out has no blind grading, so the three-vote shuffled grading of the owner's plan was not used; every criterion is a script.
not_run: Public tasks h1 to h18 with ours and the new arms (Rule A and Rule B on the held-out set decide whether this phase starts; session budget also bound it).
F9 (Haiku and Opus, 1 run per task) and F6 (independent 10 percent re-grade).
